capability: Check the work between every step of a chain
title: Check every join in the chain.

hook.picture: Close on a line in five segments; the first is calm and each next segment wobbles more; at the end a pod answers ✕ (rust chip).

problem_in_viewer_words.body: Step one was fine. By step five it was nonsense.
problem_in_viewer_words.who: anyone running a multi-step AI workflow

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Three-times device: three more chains run, every 2 beats, then 1, then ½, the wobble growing faster.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: Each step passes its mistakes along.

stakes.body: One small early slip spreads into a useless final result, and you only find it at the end.

solution_hint: Check the work between every step.

metaphor.body: Where each step hands to the next there is a seam with a small gate; a wobbly step is stopped and redone at its own seam.

steps.picture: At each join a dashed seam appears with a small gate.
Push-in: a wobbly segment hits its seam gate and is stopped; it is redone and passes calm.
steps.words: Bad step? Stopped and redone right there.

steps.picture: The whole chain runs calm; each seam ticks as the work passes.
steps.words: The wobble never reaches the end.

steps.picture: The chain with its ticked seams sits still.

real_case.claim: meta-prompting-plugin chains commands with a quality check at each step; its README diagram shows quality 0.42, 0.71, then 0.88 (an illustration), with retry on failure.

honest_limit.picture: The first step was aimed at the wrong pod; every seam passes; the calm line arrives at the wrong pod; ✕.
honest_limit.words: Every step checked. Wrong goal anyway.

not_this.body: Checked steps can still chase the wrong goal.

ending_pattern.body: FELT close shot of the five segments: now calm from first to last, every seam ticked; the pod at the end answers ✓.
ending_pattern.callback: In FELT the wobble grew segment by segment into a ✕; the same five segments now stay calm to a ✓.

end_belief.body: Check between steps, not just at the end.
